title: SEKA Spear 产品页与规格数据
notes: China specification block: front and rear maximum tire 32C (前后最大胎容量为32C), BSA threaded 68 mm, 700C. RDC 685 g and Standard 780 g are size-M bare-frame weights excluding paint and metal parts; an RDC Shadow Black size M is 729 g ±35 g. Vertical compliance 109 N/mm, 23% above Exceed; seatpost fatigue test 85 mm behind the post for 150,000 cycles at 144 kg, against the ISO reference of 70 mm, 50,000 cycles and 120 kg. Materials described for Spear: TeXtreme base layers, DIALEAD pitch-based 65T/80T and Pyrofil 30T/40T (FAW69) fibre, PMI foam filling and one-mould True-One-Piece construction. Rapier bar: 360–415 mm widths with 80–130 mm stems.
